categories.evidence: Touches CBlockIndex thread safety annotations and locking in RPC handlers; does not affect peer-to-peer networking or protocol messages.
categories.rationale: Not a P2P PR; the keyword match was triggered by a passing mention of getblockfrompeer in the description.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies getblockheader and getchaintxstats RPC implementations to enforce cs_main lock acquisition when accessing block index fields.
categories.rationale: Prevents data races when RPCs access block index metadata concurrently with block processing. The PR description notes that 'reading nTx from the getblockheader RPC may race as it does not acquire cs_main' and 'm_chain_tx_count may race in getchaintxstats'. While undefined behavior from unlocked reads should be eliminated, the issue represents an edge-case concurrency defect rather than an active crash or breakage.
